spell_note: block N = discipline N (1 Sorc/Buc, 2 Knight/Slash, 3 Archer/Feather, 4 Necro/Mortimer, 5 Enchnt/Obliky, 6 Conjur/Alexi) — pinned from code + guide. The spell bought (price record) and the spell cast (rank-table record) are different objects, joined by the caster's +0x25 byte and rank.
rank_note: 6 distinct effect tables (ranks 7-10 reuse rank 2's table), 21 records x 6 B each, indexed by the caster's +0x25 byte. Cost = w4 * (modifier+1) * 3, modifier = (caster.+0x2C >> 8) & 3 ($3C2C0). Records 19 and 20 are identical in every table (rec 19 is the top spell). Cast/resist/hit poses are figure templates 16-19 / 20-23 / 24-27.
discipline_note: 'Arrow' vs 'Feather': the fan guide calls the archer Arrow, the ROM name is Feather (name 61); also a spell named Arrow (block 3, rec 44). Unresolved until a live new-game character-creation trace (#020). Do not rename either in the remake.
